pipelineIntro.heading: What this pipeline does
pipelineIntro.poweredBy: Powered by Claude Opus 4.8 — Anthropic's most powerful AI model.

follow_up_recommendations.tagline: Turn every call outcome into the next best action.
follow_up_recommendations.summary: After every meaningful call, it turns the outcome into a concrete next step — who to call back, when, and what to say — so a warm lead never goes cold while you move on to the next dial.

howItWorks.title: Instant, rule-based action
howItWorks.description: The moment you log an outcome like interested, follow-up, callback, meeting booked or sale, Ringee creates the next-best action with a sensible priority and due date — no AI required, no waiting.

howItWorks.title: Optional AI refinement
howItWorks.description: A batch pass sharpens each recommendation: it adjusts the priority, writes the reason and a suggested message, picks the next best action, and clears out the ones that no longer matter.

howItWorks.title: Analyzed per context
howItWorks.description: Campaign, organization and personal calls are analyzed independently, so a busy campaign never drowns out your other follow-ups.

benefits: A prioritized follow-up queue instead of scattered notes
A suggested message and next best action for each lead
Due dates and decay so you act while the lead is still warm
Nothing slips through the cracks after a good call
follow_up_recommendations.bestFor: Reps and teams running outbound who close over several touches rather than one call.
follow_up_recommendations.dataNote: Works from your first logged outcome. Recommendations get sharper as more calls are analyzed; very short calls are skipped.

objection_intelligence.tagline: Discover what blocks your prospects and how to respond.
objection_intelligence.summary: It reads your real conversations to reveal what most often stops prospects from buying — and gives you a tested, editable response for each objection, so the whole team can handle it the same winning way.

howItWorks.title: Code measures the numbers
howItWorks.description: Ringee counts every objection across your analyzed calls, how often each one appears, and how often the call still converted — so the numbers are trustworthy and trend cleanly across runs.

howItWorks.title: AI explains and recommends
howItWorks.description: On a curated sample, AI surfaces what each objection really means, the patterns that win versus the ones that kill the deal, and a recommended response — and even discovers objections you never predefined.

howItWorks.title: Ranked, with a confidence level
howItWorks.description: Objections are ranked by prevalence per context, with a confidence badge that rises as more conversations are analyzed.

benefits: A ranked leaderboard of what actually blocks your deals
"What they really mean" plus winning and losing patterns from your own calls
A ready-to-use response you can edit, save, or add to your script
New objections discovered by AI that you had not thought of
objection_intelligence.bestFor: Teams who want every rep handling the toughest objections with the response that already works.
objection_intelligence.dataNote: Needs real conversations with usable transcripts. Around 25+ analyzed calls per context unlock higher-confidence insights.
